name.value: Day's Century Growers Fruit Stand and Packing House

description.value: A 136-acre family farm in the heart of the Okanagan that has been operated by the Day family for over 120 years across five generations. The on-farm stand opens mid-July with seasonal produce including sweet corn, tomatoes, and cantaloupe, all grown on-site. Their Bartlett, Bosc, and D'Anjou pears are graded on a state-of-the-art electronic line and shipped to stores across Canada.
